turn.content: Evidence confirms: there is only one goods receipt (GR-2026-0226) covering the full PO quantities, and INV-EOS-00563 already billed that delivery in full for the same total. This invoice bills the same goods again — a resubmission.

tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "possible_duplicate", "line": null, "cause": "resubmission", "evidence": [{"kind": "ledger_invoice", "ref": "INV-EOS-00563", "detail": "Earlier invoice dated 2026-09-16 for PO-2026-0226 with the identical total 5386164.00, already in our ledger."}, {"kind": "goods_receipt", "ref": "GR-2026-0226", "detail": "The only goods receipt for PO-2026-0226, received 2026-09-13, covering the full PO quantities (4 toner, 8 pens, 5 files)."}, {"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0226", "detail": "PO lines match this invoice exactly: 4 x 763900, 8 x 50100, 5 x 279200."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-026#4.3", "detail": "Each delivery may be invoiced once only; a resubmission under a different number will be rejected."}, {"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0226", "detail": "No second delivery exists; GR-2026-0226 is the sole goods receipt for this PO."}], "explanation": "There is only one goods receipt (GR-2026-0226) covering the full PO quantities, and the earlier invoice INV-EOS-00563 already billed that entire delivery for the same total, so total invoiced quantity (earlier plus this) exceeds what was received, making this a resubmission."}]}
